story.text: A very special island is inhabited only by heros and villains. Heros always tell the truth, and villains always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Lucas, and Benjamin. Lucas said that Benjamin is a hero if and only if Benjamin is a villain. As Benjamin put it, "Lucas is a hero". So who is a hero and who is a villain? (Format your answer like: "Lucas is a hero/villain, and Benjamin is a hero/villain")

options: Lucas is a hero, Benjamin is a hero
Lucas is a hero, Benjamin is a villain
Lucas is a villain, Benjamin is a villain
Lucas is a villain, Benjamin is a hero
